# youtrack_user_group (Data Source)

Looks up a user group by name, for example `All Users` or `Registered Users`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "youtrack_user_group" "all_users" {
  name = "All Users"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID of the group.
- `ring_id` (String) ID of the group in Hub.
- `users_count` (Number) Number of users in the group.
